id: \bI made it this far. Good luck to you.
en: \bI made it this far. Good luck to you.
it: \bSono arrivato fin qui. Buona fortuna a te.

id: \bCongratulations on winning your third match. \nYour next battle will be on the right.
en: \bCongratulations on winning your third match. \nYour next battle will be on the right.
it: \bCongratulazioni per aver vinto il tuo terzo incontro. \nLa tua prossima lotta si terrà sulla destra.

id: \bHey, Monarch \PN. I know you'll try your best, because you won't win without it.
en: \bHey, Monarch \PN. I know you'll try your best, because you won't win without it.
it: \bEhi, Monarca \PN. So che darai il massimo, perché senza non vincerai.

id: \bHolding back, huh? That's what you get.
en: \bHolding back, huh? That's what you get.
it: \bTi sei trattenuto, eh? Ecco cosa ti succede.

id: \bWe've both definitely improved from last time, but I still can't believe how that went.
en: \bWe've both definitely improved from last time, but I still can't believe how that went.
it: \bSiamo entrambi migliorati parecchio dall'ultima volta, ma ancora non riesco a credere a com'è andata.
